definitions.explanation: Having pale, light skin. Traditionally a compliment in Japan, especially for women and babies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{色白|いろじろ}だ。
{色白|いろじろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
「{色白|いろじろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七難|しちなん}⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It has long been said that a fair complexion hides seven flaws.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {色白|いろじろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七難|しちなん}⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧: a fair complexion hides seven flaws (old saying)
- {色白|いろじろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: fair skin
- {色白|いろじろ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a fair-skinned person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {色黒|いろぐろ}: dark-skinned, tanned — the opposite
- ⟦{美白|びはく}→美白：16979_bihaku⟧: skin whitening — the cosmetics term

CULTURAL NOTE:
Pale skin has long been an ideal of beauty in Japan, which is one reason parasols, sunscreen and ⟦{美白|びはく}→美白：16979_bihaku⟧ cosmetics are so widely used.
